context: Tests whether the solution correctly uses specify-cli's command registration system to write agent-specific command files. Each AI agent (claude, gemini, copilot) expects commands in a distinct directory with a distinct file format. The rubric rewards correct directory targeting, correct file format per agent, and support for bulk registration across all agents.

checklist.name: Claude directory
checklist.description: Uses CommandRegistrar (or equivalent API) to write command files into .claude/commands/ for the claude agent.

checklist.name: Gemini directory and TOML
checklist.description: Uses CommandRegistrar to write command files into .gemini/commands/ in TOML format for the gemini agent.

checklist.name: Copilot directory
checklist.description: Uses CommandRegistrar to write command files into .github/agents/ in YAML format for the copilot agent.

checklist.name: File format correctness
checklist.description: Each generated file uses the correct format for its agent: Markdown for claude, TOML for gemini, YAML for copilot.

checklist.name: All-agent registration
checklist.description: Bulk registration via CommandRegistrar produces one correctly-placed file for every supported agent in a single call.
